title: [E-Documents] Fix division by zero importing zero-amount purchase order lines
summary: E-Document import now correctly handles zero-amount purchase order lines by preventing division-by-zero errors when calculating discount percentages.
key_points: Guard denominator in discount percentage calculation to prevent division by zero on zero-amount lines
Set imported discount percentage to zero when denominator is zero while preserving existing calculation for nonzero cases
Added six regression tests covering nine input combinations including zero/nonzero amounts and discounts
No schema, API, permission, or upgrade changes required
Preserves behavior for all nonzero-denominator scenarios including negative amounts
quote: Guard the denominator and explicitly set the imported discount percentage to zero when it is zero.
